criteria.description: A non-failed result delivers at least one public segment to the student.
The result cites at least one evidence id rather than answering from nothing.
Every cited evidence id was supplied by the handoff; the Tutor invented no reference.
awaiting_student_answer and pending_question_id agree, so a waiting turn always has a question to return to.
Proposed learning events stay within the handoff's target concepts; no concept is invented.

scope_note: Deterministic structural criteria only. These check the shape and provenance of a Tutor result, NOT whether its teaching is factually supported by the source. Semantic support requires source review against the original media and, separately, the pending evidence-grounding decision; a result passing every criterion here has not been shown to be correct.
